sections.Profile:
"Spinball" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Chicago Coin Machine Manufacturing Company on May 24, 1948. The game features two flippers, eleven passive bumpers, a central spinning bumper, and three kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co.
- Years made: 1948
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Hawaii, Single Player, Travel, Wood Rail, Dancing, Original Theme, Music
